_status: M2 occurrence rates, built 17 Oct 2026 in three layers; every row records its source. Rates are uncertain by about one decade; eval/residual_risk_band.py varies each over +-1 decade (log-uniform). Values marked PENDING need the owner's lookup before freeze.

layer1_subsystem_prior._derivation: lambda_EPS = share_EPS * H(1 yr) / 8766 h, H(t) = (t / theta)^beta (single Weibull with PNZ, infant mortality included, DOA excluded)

weibull.source: Langer & Bouwmeester 2016, 'Reliability of CubeSats - Statistical Data, Developers' Beliefs and the Way Forward', AIAA/USU SmallSat, p. 3 (178 CubeSats, MLE single Weibull PNZ fit)

eps_share.source: Langer & Bouwmeester 2016, Figure 5 text: EPS causes more than 40 % of all failures after 30 days

cross_check.value: 41.3 % of small satellites launched 2000-2016 failed or partially failed

layer1_subsystem_prior.limitation: CubeSat data (largely university missions, infant mortality); Castet & Saleh 2009 subsystem Weibull fits for larger spacecraft (RESS 94(11):1718-1728) could not be accessed here and are not used; flight-grade EPS rates are expected lower. The +-1 decade band covers part of this.

layer2_parts_split._method: lambda_mode = lambda_EPS * parts_block / parts_total / modes_in_block. PROPOSED part counts for the 8S4P reference EPS; equal generic failure rate per part until MIL-HDBK-217F Notice 2 parts-count tables (lambda_g x pi_Q, environment SF) are looked up (PENDING).
layer2_parts_split.source: MIL-HDBK-217F Notice 2, parts-count method (structure); part counts PROPOSED, to be replaced by the M2 parts list

BCR.note: switching converter: MOSFETs, diodes, inductor, controller, sense

PDM.note: 3 channels x latching current limiter (5 parts each)

layer3_environment._method: lambda = r_bit x sensitive bits x P(SDC | upset); P(SDC | upset) from results/fault_injection.json (rule-of-three upper bound when no SDC is seen)

r_bit_per_bit_day.source: results/seu_rates.json (eval/spenvis_seu.py): SPENVIS 4.6.14, AP-8 MIN, ESP-PSYCHIC total fluence, ISO 15390 GCR, 2 mm Al, 1-year mission from 2027-01-01, CREME constant-LET; GEO check vs Roche 2009 passed (D_mid 0.79x heavy ion, 0.41x proton)
r_bit_per_bit_day.device_note: D_high (sigma_lim 2e-7 cm2/bit, top of ST 65 nm range) is the main value: SPENVIS proton models may underestimate low-energy proton direct ionisation in deep-submicron SRAM. D_low/D_mid in seu_rates.json bound it from below; the +-1 decade band covers D_low..D_high for the 2 mm runs.
